answer: Each agent identity is accepted only after remote attestation verifies its enclave’s MRENCLAVE and binds a signing key to the attested context. Copying a virtual machine alone cannot reproduce hardware-rooted attestation; under a policy requiring distinct hardware-backed keys, creating identities can require access to physical silicon rather than VM duplication. MRENCLAVE is not itself device-unique, so issuance controls matter: haven, spiral, and zephyr are merely labels.
